<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to find which statement is correct about DigiRL framework's interaction with emulator.

We look at passage. Several points: In section 2, they mention "our agent executes tasks in parallel and produce trajectories", using Android learning environment that supports running up to 64 emulators. In pipeline, action space: tapping, sliding based on normalized coordinates, typing text, pressing buttons. That's mentioned early in problem statement: "following the action space in prior literature [31], the available actions include tapping and sliding based on normalized (x, y) coordinates ... typing text strings ... pressing HOME, BACK, ENTER". So statement B: "The all possible actions for the agent in the DigiRL framework include tapping and swiping on the screen using normalized (x, y) coordinates and typing variable-length text inputs." Yes includes tap, slide (swipe). So B is correct. Check others: A: mentions percentages; not correct. C: automatic curriculum uses instruction-level value function to prioritize difficult tasks, but statement says "filter out easy tasks, focusing solely on tasks it has not yet encountered". That's somewhat inaccurate: It uses V_instruct to prioritize tasks with high advantage (i.e., hard). But not necessarily focus solely on tasks never encountered. So C is wrong. D: Cross-entropy loss is applied to training both value functions, not exclusively to policy. So D wrong. So correct answer B. Provide reasoning: B.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\[
\boxed{B}
\]
